# Westen House

Westen House, an isometric adventure for the MSX1 by Santiago Ontañón
Villar (Brain Games, 2021-2023), under the Apache License 2.0
(`LICENSE`), from https://github.com/santiontanon/westen (release
v1.3.1, `westen1.3.1.rom`, the English version, SHA-256
e50dbcdd682d531544d62a55d3548ebb48662c0d2b387d29b97666af5ea29ed6),
unchanged. A cartridge of 48 KB. It comes with MyNOS's msx package
(`games/westen.rom`): type `msx westen`.

Professor Edward Kelvin must collect the research notes of his late
colleague Jonathan Westen before the family takes the house. The arrows
walk; Space and M are a joystick's two buttons (its `input.asm` reads
the arrows, Space, and K to R); the game's screens say the rest.
